name: TOPkit - TOPdesk Support Tool

description: A tool to help you support your customers in TOPdesk.

open-quick-assist.description: Toggle the TOPkit Quick Assist window

open-topbot.description: Open TOPbot in the injected TOPkit frame

content_security_policy: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; child-src 'self' https://storage.gra.cloud.ovh.net https://www.youtube.com https://www.youtube-nocookie.com; frame-src 'self' https://storage.gra.cloud.ovh.net https://www.youtube.com https://www.youtube-nocookie.com
